About

Engineer by training, project leader by practice.

I oversee project planning, resource allocation and execution at Genuine Leaf Tobacco Ltd. (GLT), making sure every build meets quality, safety and technical standards. My path runs from electrical engineering and PLC design to leading multi-discipline teams of vendors, contractors and engineers.

I focus on cost-effective solutions, thorough training for operations and maintenance teams, and continuous process improvement, so plants don't just start up, they keep running.
